observations: Photo 0 shows a white Xbox One console with a white and blue controller on top, placed on a wooden surface. The console has a perforated front grille and the Xbox logo on the bottom right.

Photo 1 shows the same console from a side angle, revealing the disc slot and ports. The blue controller is on top, and the white controller is behind it. The console appears to be in good physical condition with no visible damage.
Photo 2 shows the console from a top-down angle, with both controllers placed on top. The blue controller is on the left, white on the right. The console's front grille and Xbox logo are visible.
All photos show the console and controllers in a clean, well-lit environment, with no visible signs of damage or wear.
The seller claims the console is 'Neatly Uk Used', 'in good condition', and includes '2 pad' and 'Fc26 Package'.

identity.kind: Xbox One console with two controllers

claims.claim: Neatly Uk Used Xbox One available
claims.evidence: The console appears clean and undamaged, but there is no visible proof of origin (UK) or usage history. The term 'neatly used' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.
All photos show no visible damage to the console or controllers. The console's front grille and ports appear intact.
The seller mentions 'Fc26 Package' but does not show it. No packaging, cables, or accessories are visible in any photo. This claim cannot be verified remotely.
Two controllers are clearly visible in all three photos: one white and one blue, placed on top of the console.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and playing a game or running a system menu.

risks.risk: Controllers may be non-functional or have damaged buttons/axes
risks.proof: A video showing both controllers connecting to the console and responding to button presses and joystick movements.

risks.risk: Console may be a counterfeit or non-genuine unit
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label, or a video showing the console's system settings screen.

risks.risk: Fc26 Package may not be included or may be incomplete
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the Fc26 package (e.g., cables, power adapter, or accessories) laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of both controllers connecting and working with the console.
Close-up photo of the console's serial number and model label.
Photo or video of the Fc26 package included.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
